intro:
They took his favorite toy.
Now this little monkey is fighting through the whole school to get it back.
description:
They took his favorite toy. They picked the wrong monkey.

What was supposed to be the first day of school turns into an all-out rescue mission when a gang of bullies steals Punch Monkey’s most treasured possession.

PUNCH MONKEY REVENGE is a stylish action adventure packed with slow-motion stunts, fast combos, cartoon chaos, and one very determined little primate.

Slow down time in mid-air to dodge attacks, dive through danger, and pull off the perfect comeback. Chain together punches, kicks, spins, tumbles, and environmental attacks as you fight your way through classrooms, hallways, playgrounds, and more.

Turn almost anything into a weapon. Grab slingshots, banana guns, lunch trays, dodgeballs, and whatever else you can get your hands on to send the school’s toughest bullies flying.

Every encounter is built for cinematic action and slapstick comedy. Leap over attacks, improvise with your surroundings, and turn each fight into your own over-the-top action scene.

The bullies have the toy.

Punch Monkey is coming to get it back.

• Stylish slow-motion action
• Fast, expressive combo combat
• Ridiculous weapons and environmental attacks
• Cartoon comedy and cinematic stunts
• Battle through a school full of increasingly tough troublemakers
• One small monkey with a very big reason to fight
